packages.name: blender
packages.versionModel: newest blender-*-windows-x64.zip entry in the official https://download.blender.org/release/Blender5.2/ listing (5.2.3 LTS, published 2026-10-22); PE FileVersion only stamps major.minor (5.2), so verifyPEVersion is not used and the version is anchored to the listing plus its published .sha256 file
packages.discovery: regex provider on the official release directory listing; urlTemplate renders Blender{major}.{minor}/blender-{version}-windows-x64.zip from the discovered version
packages.publisherCheck: official blender-5.2.3.sha256 lists 723f08a4... for blender-5.2.3-windows-x64.zip; an independent curl download recomputes the same digest; the .msi/.msix/.tar.xz entries are excluded by the asset pattern

authenticode.subject: CN=Blender Foundation, O=Blender Foundation, L=Amsterdam, S=Noord-Holland, C=NL
authenticode.signatureRule: "signature": "blender.exe" — the signed main binary inside the unsigned zip container, checked during every checkLayout run (steam.exe rule form)

layout.required: blender-launcher.exe and 5.2/python/bin/python.exe asserted present (launcher and bundled CPython are part of the portable model); full tree kept: versioned 5.2/ datafiles+scripts+python, blender.shared/ codec and render DLLs, blender.crt/ VC runtime

commandModel.consoleSubsystem: blender.exe is a CONSOLE-subsystem binary and prints 'Blender 5.2.3 LTS' + build hash for --version natively and through a Piko shim, no wrapper needed
commandModel.payloadOnlyEntries: blender-launcher.exe (update-aware launcher, semantics not verified) and the blender_debug_*.cmd / blender_system_info.cmd helpers are kept as files but deliberately not exposed as commands

stateModel.notOwned: user preferences, startup files and installed addons live in %APPDATA%\Blender Foundation\Blender\, written by the application; Piko does not own or migrate that tree

isolatedInstall.pikoHome: temporary directory with a local HTTP source copy
isolatedInstall.files: 6524 payload files (29 root entries incl. blender.exe, blender-launcher.exe and the .cmd helpers) + install record
isolatedInstall.shimDispatch: __shim blender --version -> 'Blender 5.2.3 LTS', build hash e13b728c6880, branch blender-v5.2-release
isolatedInstall.uninstallReinstallCycle: payload fully removed (only an empty apps/blender directory remains); reinstall + use + shim pass

checks.updateCheck: node scripts/update.mjs --check --packages blender -> status current (live listing fetch)
checks.compactCheck: changedPackages 1 = pre-existing sunlogin drift (blender is already a byte-stable template document)
checks.netNote: a first net.download attempt of the 405 MB archive hit the updater's HTTP timeout; checkLayout was completed against the locally cached, digest-verified copy, and the isolated install re-downloaded the archive successfully through the client

notVerified: Editor GUI workflows, rendering (Cycles/OptiX/HipRT/oneAPI) and add-on installation
